function.description: List your x402 payment requests (invoices) and their status, or (assets=true) the assets an invoice may be paid in
function.name: x402_invoice_x402_invoices

assets.description: True: list the asset ids an invoice may name (asset_id), not the invoices

status.description: Filter: pending|settling|completed|settled_no_tx|expired|refund_due (default all; refund_due = a settled payment we owe back)
